_doc: Fixtures + thresholds for .harmony/probe-media-open.sh (s-rta-0928b mediaopen, .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0928b/plan-mediaopen.md 4.10 + HARMONY ADOPTION). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-media-open.py. Fixtures are generated per run into <out>/media (videos by ffmpeg, PNGs by PIL): every path is new to the app instance.
_stallMaxMs: the longest message-thread wait of a heartbeat ping (peak_message_stall_ms, polled every 15 ms) during a load / a sequence drop
_dropStall4kMaxMs: a 4K video drop still opens the video (and, until the video lane lands its open()-time thumbnail, makes the full-frame thumbnail) on the message thread -- reported, bounded
_holdMaxPerDrop: a drop's fence wraps only the setClip: it holds the canvas for 1-2 frames (120 Hz display)
_presenceMaxS: MediaPresence sweeps once a second: a deleted / restored file is seen within one period + a message-loop hop
_boxTol: dbox(X, Y): both arrays box-averaged in 16x16 blocks, then mean |diff| over RGB (0..255) -- probe-image-load's measure
_speedMinPlayhead: a 3 s clip that plays at speed 1.0 is at ~0.33 after 1 s; a clip loaded at speed 0 stays at 0.0
